verses.text: From Paul, Silas and Timothy, to the church of the people of Thessalonica, who belong to God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Brothers and sisters, we must always thank God for you, and it is right to do so. Your faith is growing more and more, and the love every one of you has for each other is overflowing.
So we ourselves boast about you among God's churches. We tell them how you keep going and keep your faith through all the attacks and troubles you are suffering.
All this clearly shows that God judges rightly. Because of it you will be counted worthy of God's kingdom, which you are suffering for.
God is fair. He will pay back trouble to those who trouble you,
and he will give rest to you who are troubled, and to us as well. This will happen when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven in blazing fire with his mighty angels.
He will punish those who do not know God and those who do not obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus.
They will be punished with ruin that lasts for ever. They will be shut out from the Lord's presence and from his glorious power.
This will happen on the day he comes to receive glory among his holy people, and to be praised by all who have believed. And that includes you, because you believed what we told you.

With this in mind, we always pray for you. We pray that our God will make you worthy of the life he called you to. We pray that by his power he will help you do every good thing you want to do, and every work that comes from your faith.
Then the name of our Lord Jesus will be honoured because of you, and you will be honoured because of him. This all comes from the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
